The attached application must be filled out completely to include the names, addresses and
signature(s) of the applicant(s). A Pre-Application Review is required with the application.
Along with the application and conference checklist, PDF copy of a site plan, showing the
proposed transaction must be provided. The map must be drawn to scale and include the following
information:
1. The boundary lines, dimensions and areas of the original parcel(s).
2. The proposed division lines, dimensions, and areas of each parcel to be created.
3. The identification of each parcel with a number or letter.
4. All existing buildings, structures, wells, septic systems, and other improvements and their
distances from proposed or existing property lines, or a note stating there are no improvements
on the property.
5. The location and width of any abutting public or private road right-of-way.
6. The location of proposed or existing private road easements with the connection to a public
road.
7. North arrow and scale.
A copy of the current recorded deed(s) showing transfer of title, of the original parcel involved in
the transaction, to the applicant(s).
THE FILING FEE FOR A TPM APPLICATION IS $1,758.04 (plus $37.14 PER PARCEL CREATED).
A Health Department review fee of $305.00 is required for this application.
An Environmental Review fee of $291.51 along with a completed application is required.
Approval of the application will require the filing of a Parcel Map, prepared by a Licensed Land
Surveyor or a Registered Civil Engineer authorized to perform land surveying; those fees are
separate from Fresno County’s fees.
**THE PARCEL MAP FILING FEE IS $4,830.68 (plus $142.94 PER PARCEL CREATED)
THE FOLLOWING FEES APPLY TO APPLICATIONS REQUIRING AN INITIAL STUDY:
$1,364.12, plus $338.00 for Health Department Review. An Archaeological Review fee of $75.00 on a
separate check made out to CSU Bakersfield may also be required. If an Initial Study is required during
the mapping application process, the $291.51 Environmental Review fee will be credited towards the
$1,364.12 Initial Study fee.
